newsitem.title: USA: IVC Industries expects FY97 net profit.
newsitem.headline: IVC Industries expects FY97 net profit.

text.p: IVC Industries Inc said Friday it expects to report about $28 million in revenues for its fourth quarter ended July 31, up from $21 million in the same period last year.

The company also said it expects to post a net profit for the year, ended July 31, despite costs associated with launching the Revlon line, the start up of Intergel's operations and about $3 million in costs related to the merger with Hall Laboratories in April.
Intergel is the company's division devoted to soft gelatin encapsulation. Revlon is a line of vitamins and nutritional supplements marketed under a license agreement with Revlon Inc.
Revenues for the year ended July 31 increased to about $105 million, up from $88 million the prior year, the company said.
The higher revenues were attributed to growth throughout all major segments of the company, particularly a strong showing in its West Coast division, Intergel and Revlon.
The company said it expects significant revenue growth from Intergel in the 1997 fiscal year, which would be its first full year of operations.
